grammar.title: 形容词比较级和最高级的构成
grammar.definition: 大多数单音节形容词加 -er/-est（small→smaller→smallest）；重读闭音节双写末尾辅音（big→bigger→biggest，thin→thinnest）；以 -e 结尾加 -r/-st（large→larger→largest）；辅音字母+y 变 i（easy→easier，heavy→heavier）；较长形容词用 more/most；不规则词须熟记：good→better→best，bad→worse→worst。
grammar.usage: 这是第 107/108 课的核心语法，先记规则再套句型。

examples.en: small — smaller — smallest
examples.zh: 小的 — 更小的 — 最小的

examples.en: good — better — best
examples.zh: 好的 — 更好的 — 最好的

grammar.title: 比较级与最高级的用法
grammar.structure: 比较级 + than（两者）；the + 最高级 + in/of 短语（三者以上）
grammar.definition: 比较级用于两者之间的比较，通常与 than 连用；所指清楚时可单独用（This coat is longer.）。最高级用于三者或以上，前面必须加 the，并常带表示范围的介词短语（in the shop / in our class）。
grammar.usage: It's smaller than the blue one. / This is the largest dress in the shop.

examples.en: I think the blue dress is prettier.
examples.zh: 我认为那件蓝色的更漂亮些。

examples.en: That girl is the tallest student in our class.
examples.zh: 那位姑娘是班上个子最高的学生。

grammar.title: too / as well 与 either
grammar.structure: 肯定句用 too 或 as well（句末）；否定句用 either（句末）
grammar.definition: too 和 as well 表示「也」，一般不用于否定句；否定句中表示「也（不）」要用 either。
grammar.usage: too small for me as well / I don't like the colour either.

examples.en: I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well.
examples.zh: 恐怕这件绿裙子我穿着也太小。

examples.en: I don't like the colour either.
examples.zh: 我也不喜欢这种颜色。

drill.q: I am ___er than you are. — I am the ___est in the class.
drill.zh: 我比你更……。我是班里最……的。（比较级 + than；最高级 + the ... in ...）

slots.zh: 胖的 → fatter → fattest（双写 t）
瘦的 → thinner → thinnest（双写 n）
大的 → bigger → biggest（双写 g）

answers: I am older than you are. I am the oldest in the class.
I am fatter than you are. I am the fattest in the class.
It is cool today, but it was cooler yesterday.

questions.q: What kind of dress does the lady want?
questions.zh: 这位女士想要什么样的服装？
questions.a: She wants a blue dress like the blue one — pretty and in her size.
questions.aZh: 她想要一件像那件蓝裙子一样的（漂亮的、合她尺寸的）蓝色连衣裙。
questions.hint: 听 Could you show me another blue dress? ... it must be my size.

questions.q: Why doesn't the lady want the green dress?
questions.zh: 女士为什么不要那件绿裙子？
questions.a: Because it's too small for her too — smaller than the blue one; she doesn't like the colour either, and it doesn't suit her at all.
questions.aZh: 因为它对她来说也太小（比蓝的还小）；她也不喜欢那颜色，而且根本不适合她。
questions.hint: too small ... as well / I don't like the colour either.

questions.q: What does the assistant say about short skirts?
questions.zh: 店员关于短裙说了什么？
questions.a: He says short skirts are in fashion now, and asks the lady to try the green dress.
questions.aZh: 他说短裙现在很流行，并请女士试一试那件绿裙子。

questions.q: Does the assistant have a larger dress? What does he say?
questions.zh: 店员有更大的裙子吗？他是怎么说的？
questions.a: No. He says he's afraid he hasn't got a larger dress — this is the largest dress in the shop.
questions.aZh: 没有。他说恐怕没有更大的了，这是店里最大的一件。
questions.hint: 最后一句：I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress.

questions.q: Why do we say 'I don't like the colour either' instead of 'too'?
questions.zh: 为什么说 I don't like the colour either 而不说 too？
questions.a: too and as well are used in affirmative sentences; in negative sentences we use either (I don't like it either).
questions.aZh: too 和 as well 用于肯定句；否定句要用 either（我也不喜欢……）。
questions.hint: 对比：I like it, too. / I don't like it, either.

questions.q: I am older than you are. — I am the oldest in the class.
questions.zh: 第 108 课操练：用比较级 ...er than + 最高级 the ...est in ... 描述人与物。
questions.a: I am fatter than you are. I am the fattest in the class.
questions.aZh: 我比你胖。我是班里最胖的。

title: It's too small / 比较级与最高级
subtitle: 它太小了 / 形容词的比较级与最高级

lead.question: 在服装店试衣服：这件太小、那件更小、蓝色那件最漂亮——「更」「最」用英语怎么说？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。买衣服必备三句话：① It's too small for me.（对我来说太小）；② It's smaller than the blue one.（比那件蓝的还小——比较级 + than）；③ This is the largest dress in the shop.（店里最大——最高级 + the + in 短语）。构成上注意 small→smaller→smallest，big→bigger→biggest（双写），pretty→prettier→prettiest（变 y 为 i），不规则的好—better—best。先把这些变一变，再陪女士去挑裙子。
goals: 掌握形容词比较级 -er + than 的用法（两者比较）
掌握最高级 the + -est + in/of 短语的用法（三者以上）
掌握比较级/最高级的构成规则：-er/-est、双写辅音、-y→i、more/most、不规则
会用 in fashion、as well、not ... at all、Could you ...? 等购物表达
lead.summary: 第 107 课女士逛服装店：蓝裙子颜色漂亮却太小；店员推荐绿色裙——很时髦、短裙正流行——可她穿着也太小，而且比蓝的还小；她也不喜欢绿颜色，觉得根本不合适，还是蓝的漂亮，想要一件同样款式、合她尺寸的蓝裙子，可惜店员说这已是店里最大的一件。第 108 课集中操练比较级（...er than）与最高级（the ...est in ...）。
lead.tips: ① 比较级用于两者，通常与 than 连用（It's smaller than the blue one.）；② 最高级用于三者以上，必须加 the，常带 in/of 范围（the largest dress in the shop）；③ 构成：small→smaller；big→bigger（重读闭音节双写）；large→larger（以 e 结尾加 -r）；easy→easier（辅音字母 + y 变 i）；不规则 good→better→best、bad→worse→worst；④ too/as well 用于肯定句，否定句用 either（I don't like the colour either.）；⑤ suit me 合我身/适合我；not ... at all 根本不……。
